summary: Acadia Realty Trust filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 9,000,000 common shares via forward sale agreements with Bank of America, Jefferies, Truist, and Wells Fargo. The forward purchasers will borrow and sell shares; Acadia receives proceeds only upon physical settlement, expected within 12 months. The last reported price was $22.59 per share on June 9, 2026. No special-situation event: this is a routine equity capital markets transaction to raise funds for general corporate purposes while maintaining REIT status. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or any other special situation.
